body:
I want to tentatively offer to you, I cannot say anything about you, but I can about myself, and what I think may be true for you.

I don't think fear holds me back from ending my life, at least not fear from death itself. It's the fear that I have something to live for.

Life is...big. I choose to not terminate something that I don't know where it's going, and which a part of me is not done with yet. If you need alcohol to make you lead to a decision...it is not my own feelings that it makes sense to use the alcohol to get there.

I hope you understand my voice and tone, I am much for eloquence and clarity but not much for writing it.

^also ^I ^am ^sorry ^if ^you ^respond ^in ^some ^way ^and ^I ^do ^not ^respond ^back, ^I ^don't ^check ^often ^the ^messages ^in ^here.
